about: Line budget for student-facing code (.js, .html, .css outside tests/ and tools/). New files must stay at or under the limit. Files listed below are over it on purpose: 'split-later' files come down over time; 'exception' files are documented as fine to stay large. Each listed file has a ceiling (its size when listed plus headroom so small fixes still pass). Ceilings only go down: when a file shrinks to 200+ lines under its ceiling, lower the ceiling to its new size plus headroom. Remove a file from the list once it is under the limit.

js/muenba.js.reason: Muenba world in one block; split by stage after a read-only mapping pass, as Muenba work comes up.

js/karasuki.js.reason: Karasuki world in one block; split section by section (oddities and the dev panel first) when Karasuki work comes up.

js/blitz-engine.js.reason: Shared engine for the three Blitz games; heavily tested; split only when a change gives a reason.

index.html.reason: Hub page; its CSS moved to theme/hub.css and theme/hub-panels.css in Pass 1. Inline script (about 77 KB) is what remains to move.

js/utsuroba.js.reason: Utsuroba world in one block; split when Utsuroba work comes up.

js/destruction_1.js.reason: Arcade game (Booha Destruction): self-contained, rarely changed; splitting buys little.

maze.html.reason: Maze page; its CSS moved to theme/maze.css in Pass 1. Inline script (about 85 KB) is what remains to move.

js/grimmerglen.js.reason: Grimmerglen world in one block; drawing section first when Grimmerglen work comes up.

js/invaders-engine.js.reason: Arcade game (Booha Invaders): self-contained, rarely changed.

js/destruction_levels_1.js.reason: Arcade game level data for Booha Destruction.

liar_machine.html.reason: Mister Happy's House game page (Liar Machine): self-contained, rarely changed.
